features.rationale: Continuous rectangular way plate; view breaks and H markings are not geometric discontinuities.
Seed counterbored through hole enters the front face opposite datum A; unspecified hole depth denotes through.
features.justification: D007 is the printed approximate nominal X location, subject to final assembly fit. The end view establishes counterbore entry opposite datum A.

features.rationale: Six complete counterbored holes at uniform D008 basic pitch; D009 through D012 confirm the cumulative offsets.

notes: Datum A is the +Z broad face; counterbores enter from Z=0. All hole X coordinates inherit the approximate D007 assembly-fit offset.

Hardening is manufacturing metadata, not geometry: HRD. 3 SURFACES MARKED 'H' R/C 58 MIN. .125 MIN. DEPTH. D014 and D015 define hardened band heights on the front and datum-A faces respectively; the bottom face is the third hardened surface. D016 is minimum hardened depth.
Surface texture 16 applies to both broad faces and the bottom face.
D017 is the hole-position tolerance zone diameter, not a hole size. No datum reference is printed in this frame; clarify inspection interpretation without inventing one.
D018 controls broad-face parallelism to datum A and D019 bottom-face perpendicularity to datum A; neither changes nominal geometry.
Material: MFRS STD STEEL. No fillets, chamfers or threads are specified.
